Your progress is saved in this browser whenever the game saves: at bonfires, when you pick something up or beat a boss, and every minute. Another browser or device starts its own journey.

Play together

Online play is not set up in this copy of the game yet. The person who made this page needs to put their Firebase address in web/online.json and build the page again (the README says how).

Everyone who types the same room code shares one world of signs. Press T in the game to leave a sign on the ground; everyone in the room can read it. While two or more of you are playing, a boss's fog holds shut until all of you are standing at it, and then it parts for everyone.
